messages:
maria: follow-up from the PM: the 03/12 ETL slowdown produced delayed spans and wrong rollups in analytics. we need owners, short deadlines, and a verification plan.

ajay: i'll handle detection + dashboarding. plan to add a rolling ETL latency heatmap, missing_span_counter, and a per-deploy span-reconciliation metric. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

dave: i'll take the pipeline remediation. root cause: windowing regression after the reorder change. actions: revert to pre-reorder in staging, add deterministic ordering integration test, and run a targeted backfill for 2026-03-12..14. ETA: wed COB.

sasha: alerts + CI gating here. adding Prom alert: etl_median_processing_ms > 120000 for 5m and a post-deploy synthetic that compares expected vs observed span counts. gating the new integration test in CI. ETA: tue AM.

obs-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/pms/etl-2026-03-12. spike: span-drop-rate x3; impacted dashboards: analytics-service, billing-aggregates.

maria: please attach PR links and add a 1-paragraph runbook: triage steps, backfill command id, and communication checklist for oncall. also record the recurrence pattern: similar regression ~7 weeks prior after ordering-touching deploy.

ajay: dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infra/mon/pulls/431 79. query added to PR to surface suspect batches.

dave: backfill PR + job ID: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/402 79, backfill job bf-20260315-9. staging revert commit: c4b9a7. added note about reorder assumptions.

sasha: CI PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/92 79 	adds synthetic run + postdeploy reconciliation. runbook snippet: "on span-drop spike -> halt deploys, run bf job, page oncall, and attach telemetry links."

maria: recap owners: ajay (detection/dashboard) EOD tomorrow; dave (pipeline + backfill) Wed COB; sasha (alerts + CI) Tue AM. i'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm.

ajay: i'll also prototype a low-noise anomaly detector to suppress load-related false positives and add unique_service_span_ratio to canary dashboards.

dave: added a followups checklist in the PM doc: https://redwood.docs/pm/etl-2026-03-12/followups-2026 with owners and due dates.

maria: thanks all. close when dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating live, and runbook in place. i'll post final sign-off here. :white_check_mark:
